visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a screen recording of a Google search page for '火影忍者' (Naruto) on a mobile device. Animated sprites of Naruto Uzumaki in his classic orange jumpsuit are seen running across the interface. Large, bold yellow and white text overlays appear in the center. (2) The scene cuts to a young woman with short dark hair and a beige shirt standing against a dark, cosmic space background. She performs rhythmic hand gestures resembling ninja hand seals from the anime. (3) A close-up graphic of Sasuke Uchiha's face from the manga/anime is displayed, highlighting his unique eye patterns (Sharingan and Rinnegan), while the host remains visible in a smaller inset. (4) Panels from the Naruto manga are shown, featuring Naruto looking toward a sunset and a close-up of his determined expression. Yellow subtitles continue to cycle at the bottom. (5) Back to the screen recording of the mobile interface, showing a virtual keyboard as the user types '火影忍者' into the search bar. (6) On the Google search results page, a hand icon clicks a small 'Leaf Village' symbol located in a floating action button at the bottom right. (7) Multiple Naruto sprites immediately begin running across the search results in a 'Shadow Clone' effect. The host reappears in the final shot, now wearing a Naruto headband and an orange sweater, leaning toward the camera and shouting enthusiastically.

(5) [Subtitle]: 只要在 Google 搜尋火影忍者 點擊下面的 木葉忍者村按鈕. (6) [Subtitle]: 就會跑出一堆 明人的影分身喔. (7) [Subtitle]: 狂點按鈕的話 還會跑出更多更多 快去試試看吧！ (8) [Variety]: 佐助～. [Logo]: 電獺少女.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video alternates between a mobile browser UI (Google Search), a stylized space/galaxy background for the host, and original manga panels from the Naruto series.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Chinese. A fast-paced electronic BGM with a strong synthetic beat plays underneath. A distinct 'pop' sound effect accompanies the appearance of the first Naruto sprites. (2) As the narrator mentions the manga's creator, a subtle 'shimmer' or digital chime sound effect is heard. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo. (3) When the screen recording shows typing, rapid 'mechanical click' sound effects simulate keyboard taps. The female voice remains consistently high in arousal and clarity. (4) A bright 'ding' UI sound effect plays when the hand icon clicks the Leaf Village button on the screen. (5) Immediately following the click, a series of rapid 'poof' or cloud-burst sound effects (inspired by the anime's Shadow Clone Jutsu) play as the screen fills with Naruto characters. (6) The video concludes with the host shouting 'Sasuke!' with high vocal intensity, followed by a final musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Context -> Instruction -> Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers how to trigger a hidden Google Search 'Easter Egg' created for the 25th anniversary of the Naruto manga. It uses a combination of high-energy host presentation and screen-captured instructions to drive engagement.
